title: Senior Resident in Surgical Oncology (Gynecological Oncology)
application_fee: Rs. 300/- for General/OBC; SC/ST/Female/PwD/Ex-servicemen are exempt
age_limit: Maximum 45 years, relaxable as per rules. Cut-off date is 05.12.2026.
summary: Tata Memorial Centre invites online applications from eligible Indian nationals for the position of Senior Resident in Surgical Oncology (Gynecological Oncology) at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi. The appointment is a tenure-based position for a fixed period up to 31.07.2027. Candidates must apply online through the official TMC website before the closing date of 05.12.2026.
eligibility_bullets: Possess MS/MD in Obstetrics & Gynecology or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
Mandatory registration with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council for selected candidates.
Maximum age limit is 45 years with permissible relaxations for reserved categories.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official Tata Memorial Centre careers portal at https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers.
Complete the online application form with all required personal and educational details.
Upload necessary documents, certificates, and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently employed in a government organization.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 300 online via Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI, if applicable.
Submit the completed application form online before 05.12.2026 at 05:30 PM.
